title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Tobacco Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Tobacco Edition Pre Filled Pods bring two distinct tobacco blends to the Elf Bar Dual 10K. One pod features Snoow Tobacco - light and creamy with a subtle toasted character. The other delivers Peppermint Tobacco, layering a cool mint edge over a deep, earthy base. With 5ml refill chambers included in each pod, the Dual 10K keeps both flavours running without interruption. Tobacco Edition is a great choice for vapers seeking a smooth yet flavourful alternative to standard tobacco vapes. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
